title: Kasparov’s Immortal: Mate After the Bishop Is Taken
summary: An exposed king can let the queen and rook force mate even while the opponent has two rooks and a queen.

nodes.question: Black has accepted the bishop. How does White force mate?
nodes.explanation: Qc2+ forces the king to e1. Re7+ then checks along the e-file; Black’s only block is Qe2, which the white queen can capture with mate.

branches.title: Conditional source mating net after Qxf1
commentary: Begin after the illustrated Qxf1 accepts the bishop on f1. This proves the mating variation after acceptance, not the earlier sacrifice against every defense.
Qc2+ checks Kd1 along c2–d1 and covers c1/c2/d2/e2. Black cannot capture the queen or block an adjacent diagonal check. Ke1 is the only legal reply.
Ke1 is forced. Black’s queen on f1 occupies f1, and the white queen controls the other nearby escape squares.
Re7+ brings the rook onto the e-file with check. Qc2 controls d1/d2/e2; Black can only interpose its queen on e2. Neither rook can answer this check.
Qe2 is the only legal response. The queen sacrifices itself to block Re7’s file, giving White the final capture.

Qxe2# removes the blocking queen and checks Ke1 from the adjacent square. Re7 protects Qe2, the queen covers d1/d2/f1/f2, and Black cannot capture it or block the adjacent file check. This final move completes the source’s illustrated net independently and is actual mate.

exercises.prompt: Why must Black sacrifice the queen after Re7+?
exercises.answer: The king has no legal flight, neither rook can stop the check and Qe2 is the only legal interposition.

exercises.prompt: Was this the actual continuation of the game?
exercises.answer: The source presents Qxf1 as a conditional variation. The actual game continues with Rd2; that defense and the larger conversion remain outside this selected proof.

Native53 shows the complete board before the queen capture, native54 is queen animation and native55 confirms Qxf1. Native56–58 show Qc2+/Ke1/Re7+/Qe2; the final Qxe2# is a legally verified completion of the illustrated mating net. Every Black reply to the checks is enumerated: Ke1 and Qe2 are forced. This does not prove Qxf1 was forced, certify all alternatives to Bf1, or establish the actual Rd2/Rd7 game continuation and final larger queen-versus-rook conversion.
